title: Loop Call Frame Representation
statement: Let $\mathrm{body}$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $\mathrm{anchor}$ be a state of $\mathrm{body}$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For any startup flag, body configuration $c$, release flag, optional Boolean flag value, word, and configuration $\mathrm{fuel}$ of $F$ on $x$, the loop-call configuration equals its frame representation: the frame uses the call's state, the input-head position of $c$, the tape containing the optional flag at cell $0$, the buffer tapes for $\mathrm{word}$ and $c$'s output, head positions $0$ and $|c.\mathrm{output}|$, and empty output.
